title: Acceptance and Application of RFID for Effective Warehouse Management Systems in Johor
content:
RFID integrated with IoT significantly improves warehouse management by enabling real-time inventory tracking, faster operations, and higher accuracy. The study highlights enhanced efficiency, reduced costs, and improved decision-making, demonstrating RFID as a key enabler of smart warehouse transformation in Industry 4.0 logistics environments. RFID remains a critical component of smart warehouse systems in Malaysia. The study further highlights both technological and human factors influencing RFID implementation, providing practical insights for logistics companies considering digital transformation.


ABSTRACT

This study looks at how RFID technology can be used to improve warehouse management systems, especially in Johor's logistics sector. Globalization and e-commerce have made logistics networks more complicated, but companies are being told to use technologies that make warehousing operations accurate, quick, and visible in real time. This study examined the impact of RFID, particularly when combined with internet of things technologies, on conventional warehousing procedures. It accomplished this through a qualitative case study methodology. We did semi-structured interviews with important people (supervisors and operational managers) from different logistics companies in Johor. Thematic research shows that RFID improves inventory accuracy, speeds up order processing, reduces errors made by staff, and helps people make better decisions. RFID also lets one connect and automate systems on a lot of different platforms. This makes warehouse systems more adaptable and based on data. This study adds important information to the growing but still small body of research on how RFID technology can be used. The findings indicate that RFID can facilitate the advancement of Malaysia's industry 4.0 initiatives. They also say that more research needs to be done on how easy it is to use RFID, how safe it is for data, and how good it is for the environment (e.g., how easy it is to recycle tags).
